sources.title: Société Frédéric Chopin à Paris — Les concerts
sources.citation_text: The Paris Chopin Society's dated concert record lists 26 February 1832 at the Salons Pleyel in Paris with Chopin performing his E minor piano concerto, variations and a six-piano work with Kalkbrenner.
